_comment: Community submissions. Empty until real people submit. Do NOT invent rows here — fabricated data destroys the only thing this site has, which is trust. The site falls back to clearly-labelled indicative ranges when a cohort is empty.

_schema.role: one of the role keys in assets/js/data.js (e.g. devops, swe_be) or its exact label
_schema.level: junior | mid | senior | lead | manager | head
_schema.country: AE | SA | QA | KW | BH | OM
_schema.currency: AED | SAR | QAR | KWD | BHD | OMR
_schema.base: monthly base salary, in that currency
_schema.allowances: monthly housing + transport + other cash allowances
_schema.bonus: annual bonus as a percentage of base, e.g. 10
